Name: Rain Totem Makes Thunderstorm
Author: jmtrad
Description:
[center][b]It's my first mod and is a very simple one, makes the Rain Totem cause thunderstorms. Works in any season.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mDkahsl.gif[/img]﻿

My original idea was to restore a bug from before 1.6 that using Rain Totem on a thunderstorm day would make the next day also thunderstorm. But i could not make it work, so if anyone wants to make a mod from this idea feel free.

Inside the folder you can disable the mod by editing config.json and changing the "EnableMod" from True to False.[/b][/center]
